nav.title: Demo
nav.description: A made-up two-phase plan drawn as nested tasks: three tasks at once, then two more that wait for them.

nav.title: Flow
nav.description: Nested tasks as a node graph: the parent on the left, a column per phase, an arrow for every "waits for".

nav.title: Lanes
nav.description: Nested tasks as lanes: each phase a column, left to right, with "then" between; tasks in one column run at the same time.

nav.title: Outline
nav.description: Nested tasks as an indented outline: every group of subtasks badged "together" or "then", the % at the end of each row.
